∃ (Λ : CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}) (Γ : ℕ → CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}),
  Group.FG Λ ∧
  (∀ n, Group.FG (Γ n)) ∧
  IsICC Λ ∧
  (∀ n, IsICC (Γ n)) ∧
  HasKazhdanPropertyT Λ ∧
  (∀ n, HasKazhdanPropertyT (Γ n)) ∧
  (∀ n, TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic (Γ n) Λ) ∧
  (∀ m n, TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic (Γ m) (Γ n)) ∧
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, m ≠ n → ¬ Nonempty (Γ m ≃* Γ n)) ∧
  (∀ n, ¬ Nonempty (Λ ≃* Γ n))
parsed.english: There is a finitely generated ICC Kazhdan property (T) group Λ and a sequence of finitely generated ICC property (T) groups Γ n, such that all the group von Neumann factors (with their traces) are isomorphic to each other and to that of Λ. Yet no two of the Γ m, Γ n (m ≠ n) are isomorphic as groups, and none is isomorphic to Λ. Here 'not isomorphic' is spelled out as the nonexistence of a group isomorphism.
parsed.why_clearer: It replaces the bespoke wrapper GroupsIsomorphic with the standard Mathlib notion, the nonexistence of a multiplicative equivalence `≃*`.
